feature: RSI step 3: project experience/strategy candidates and releases

behavior.entry: 任务复盘 → 候选优化与发布
behavior.scope: project-local reviewed experience and advisory strategy snapshots; no executable source modification
behavior.storage: .aistudio/agent/ immutable artifacts and append-only version events
behavior.workflow: freeze baseline → create/edit candidate → inspect difference → enter positive/negative matching cases → validate → explicitly publish
behavior.isolation: starting version management freezes current advice; working-library edits and candidate changes are inactive until publication
behavior.gates: exact project/state revision, current source-library revision, unchanged candidate validation, complete current review provenance, changed advice, positive/negative coverage and exact matching expectations
behavior.evaluation: existing TaskSpecV2 and EvaluationResultV2; deterministic offline matching, not model effectiveness
behavior.activation: publication activates one immutable snapshot; subsequent context includes release identity and renews provider context when selection changes
behavior.rollback: new append-only version pointing to retained prior snapshot; current source evidence revalidated
behavior.audit: last 20 versions and last 50 cited release/task pairs in retained event window; links to task reviews; context preparation is not execution or efficacy proof
